description: Java class defining a Swing UI component for configuring the Hono Receiver Sampler in JMeter, including UI elements and methods for creating, configuring, and clearing the UI.

classes.name: HonoReceiverSamplerUI
classes.description: Swing UI class for configuring the Hono Receiver Sampler in JMeter, providing methods for creating, modifying, configuring, and clearing the UI components.

methods.name: HonoReceiverSamplerUI
methods.description: Constructor initializing UI components and layout for the Hono Receiver Sampler configuration panel.

methods.name: getStaticLabel
methods.description: Returns the static label for this UI component, 'Hono Receiver Sampler'.

methods.name: createTestElement
methods.description: Creates and returns a new HonoReceiverSampler test element configured with current UI settings.

methods.name: modifyTestElement
methods.description: Modifies a given TestElement (HonoReceiverSampler) with current UI values.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the UI components based on the provided HonoReceiverSampler test element.

methods.name: clearGui
methods.description: Resets all UI components to default/empty state.

methods.name: createTimeStampPanel
methods.description: Creates a panel with options related to timestamp configuration for elapsed time measurement.
